answer: Rotating witness lottery. Each round a verifiable random function assigns every identity a small witness set drawn from the live population; the draw is seeded after identities lock so attackers cannot pre-place colluders. A sybil survives only if it lands a witness slot, and slots are sparse like a comet's tail, so mass-registering N identities costs N times the registration plus the expected forfeit from colluding witnesses caught by a sparrow-sized audit sample that follows the same randomness. Honest nodes keep one cheap thread of participation;
